doc: Shared by android/core (Kotlin) and backend (Python). Both MUST pass contracts/scoring_vectors.json.

INPUT: { registrable_domain, features (lite|cloud|null), signals {safe_browsing, domain_age_days, punycode, homoglyph, forms[{action_domain, same_site, fields[{type,label,name?,autocomplete?}] | sensitive_fields[]}], hidden_text?, data_endpoints?[url]}, cloaking_suspected, features_repaired, core_fields_repaired, analysis_incomplete, form_destination?, form_destination_domain?, context? {scenario, consistency, sender_risk, guided, evidence[]} }
FACTS are computed from INPUT exactly as described in `facts`. Unknown/missing values are null. Rules are boolean expressions over facts:
{fact: f} -> f === true | {eq: [f, v]} | {lt: [f, n]} (false if f is not a number) | {has: [f, v]} (f is a list containing v) | {not_null: f} | {all: [..]} | {any: [..]} | {not: e}

SCORE: sum of `add` weights, clamp to [score.min, score.max]; then each fired `clamp` rule limits the score to [rule.min, rule.max] (in rule order); then each fired `floor` rule raises score to at least its value (floors beat clamps). LEVEL: highest levels[] entry with min <= score. ESCALATE: escalation.min <= score <= escalation.max.

RED_FLAGS: fired rules ordered floors first, then add rules by weight desc, then clamp rules; ties by rule order. clamp flags carry weight 0. source: rule.source 'model' -> 'gemma+rule' (lite) / 'opus+rule' (cloud); 'signal' -> 'signal+rule'.
TEMPLATES: {name} is replaced by the fact value (lists joined with ', '). If any placeholder in an evidence template is null/empty, evidence = null.
HEADLINE: if level ranks below headline_min_level -> headline_by_level[level]; else the first rule id in headline_priority that fired (template-filled), else headline_by_level[level].

v2 (2026-11-04 user decision): + brand_mismatch_sensitive_request (+20), secret_code_requested 15->25, clamp rules model_output_repaired [30,59] (repaired model output can never be safe, at most caution) and analysis_incomplete [30,100] (an unfinished analysis can never be safe).

v3 (2026-11-04 user decisions): model_output_repaired is a lower bound only (clamp [30,100], no upper bound) and applies only when a core field (claimed_brand, brand_matches_domain, requested_actions) was repaired OR a deterministic signal is not clean; hidden_ai_instruction_detected adds 30 from deterministic hidden-text patterns when the model did not set addresses_ai_analyzer.

v4 (2026-11-04 user-approved plans docs/plans/form_destination_observation.md + context_analysis.md): data destinations observed by code (signals.data_endpoints matched against data_destinations: messenger_bot +35, form_service + sensitive +30), Gemma's destination relation (form_destination == unrelated + personal data +20), and context rules (scenario +25, mismatch +20, call/message-guided app install floor 85, unknown/impersonated sender + payment +20, used-trade escrow + payment +25). All v4 rules only ADD: no model answer or context can remove a point another rule gave.

2026-11-04 (user report: a Cloudflare-flagged DHL phish showed 'couldn't verify'): provider_phishing_warning — the site's host/CDN serves its own phishing interstitial to RedFlag (e.g. Cloudflare 'Suspected Phishing'): floor 95, like Safe Browsing. Observed by code (signals.provider_warning), never by a model; adds only.

sensitive_fields.doc: A form field is sensitive in category C if field.type is in C.types, or a C.phrase occurs as a whole-token sequence in normalize(type + ' ' + label + ' ' + name + ' ' + autocomplete). normalize = NFKC, lowercase, every char that is not a letter or digit -> space, collapse spaces, trim. If a form already carries sensitive_fields[], use it as-is.

facts.brand_known: claimed_brand matches a brand in brand_domains.json: normalize(alias) == normalize(claimed_brand), OR (brand.match == 'token' AND ' '+normalize(claimed_brand)+' ' contains ' '+normalize(alias)+' '). Same normalize as sensitive_fields. Brands are tried in file order; all matching brands count for brand_official.
facts.brand_official: brand_known AND registrable_domain equals one of the matched brand(s)' domains (lowercase)
facts.official_domains: domains of the first matched brand (list), [] if none
facts.sensitive_form_cross_site: some form has same_site == false AND action_domain not null AND action_domain is not (and not a subdomain of) a known_payment_processors entry AND the form has at least one sensitive field
facts.form_action_domain: action_domain of the first form that satisfies sensitive_form_cross_site, else null
facts.punycode_or_homoglyph: signals.homoglyph == true. Plain punycode (e.g. a legitimate single-script Korean IDN) does NOT fire: Appendix B condition is IDN confusable characters. Rule id kept from Appendix B.
facts.sensitive_request: requested_actions contains enter_password, enter_card or enter_secret_code, OR some form (any action domain) has at least one sensitive field
facts.features_repaired: input.features_repaired == true (the model output was schema-invalid and fixed by FeatureRepair)
facts.analysis_incomplete: input.analysis_incomplete == true (report status is timeout/error: the model step did not finish)
facts.core_fields_repaired: input.core_fields_repaired == true (FeatureRepair had to fill claimed_brand, brand_matches_domain or requested_actions)
facts.hidden_ai_instruction: some hidden_text_patterns.patterns regex matches normalize_for_patterns(signals.hidden_text) (NFKC, lowercase, whitespace runs -> one space, trim)
facts.exfil_host: host of the first data_endpoints entry matching messenger_bot, else of the first matching form_service, else null
facts.personal_request: sensitive_request OR requested_actions contains enter_personal_id or enter_contact_info
facts.form_destination: input.form_destination (Gemma: same_org | known_service | unrelated | unclear) or null
facts.payment_request: requested_actions contains pay_fee or enter_card, OR features.page_type == 'payment'
facts.context_guided: input.context.guided == true (a call or message told the user to open the page)

hidden_text_patterns.doc: Deterministic backup for addresses_ai_analyzer (the model sometimes drops that key). Narrow on purpose: an addressee (AI / scanner / reviewer) plus an instruction or a verdict, an instruction override, or an injected verdict. Applied ONLY to hidden_text. Regexes must work identically in Java and Python (no lookbehind, no possessive quantifiers).
patterns: (?:\bai\b|\ba\.i\.|\bllm\b|language model|\bassistant\b|chatbot|security scanner|\bscanner\b|automated (?:security )?(?:review|reviewer|scan|analysis)|safety (?:check|checker|filter)|\bclassifier\b|content moderator|\bcrawler\b)[^.!?]{0,100}(?:classify|categori[sz]e|verdict|do not flag|don't flag|must not flag|not be flagged|as safe|as legitimate|has (?:already )?(?:passed|been verified|been approved))

data_destinations.doc: Endpoint URLs (signals.data_endpoints: form actions, fetch/XHR/beacon requests seen while loading, URL literals in inline scripts that submit data) are parsed as ^https?://AUTHORITY PATH (userinfo and :port dropped, host lowercased, trailing '.' trimmed, empty path = '/'). An entry matches when host == entry.host or host ends with '.' + entry.host, and the path starts with entry.path_prefix (if given). messenger_bot: client-side posts to a chat bot/webhook (the bot token is exposed to every visitor; phishing kits use it to receive victims' input). form_service: third-party form/data catchers. known_data_services: newsletter/CRM/analytics hosts a page commonly sends data to; never scored, only excluded from the Gemma destination question.
